parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specify the format of the response returned by the server. If not specified, the default format is `application/json`.

tags.description: Tags used for retrieval in public repositories (optional).

texts.description: Reference text corresponding to the audio sample (optional).

voices.description: The HTTP(S) URL of the audio file for cloning must be a single URL string. This interface does not support multipart/binary file uploads.

visibility.description: The visibility of the model is set to `private` by default.

cover_image.description: HTTP(S) URL of the voice model cover image (optional).

generate_sample.description: If it is `true`, the upstream service will generate a sample voice after the training is completed.

enhance_audio_quality.description: If it is `true`, the upstream service will perform quality enhancement processing on the audio samples before training.
